description: Slavic given names and Christian names used by Slavic peoples (Russian, Ukrainian, Belarusian, Bulgarian, Serbian, Montenegrin, Macedonian, Bosnian, Croatian, Slovene, Polish, Czech, Slovak), one cluster per name across languages, plus common East Slavic surnames. Latin spellings cover passport systems (ICAO 2013, GOST R 52535.1-2006, MVD 1997, KMU 2010, Belarusian passport practice, Bulgarian 2009, Macedonian 2008, Gaj), BGN/PCGN, English press, German (Duden), French, Polish, Czech and South Slavic renderings.
